title: refactor(ci): modernize workflows, consolidate lint/test/release and bump actions/deps
author: Aisha Patel
description: Consolidate and modernize CI workflows across the monorepo to reduce duplication, speed up developer iteration, and make release automation more robust. This PR consolidates separate lint/test/release workflows into three unified workflows (lint, test, release) with clear matrices for repo areas, upgrades GitHub Actions to supported versions, replaces deprecated actions, and bumps Node matrices to node 20 where applicable. Motivation: current CI is fragmented across 6 workflow files producing repeated setup steps, inconsistent caching, and long maintenance cycles. Goals: 1) Reduce duplicate job setup and speed up common jobs via a shared reusable workflow pattern; 2) Improve caching and build matrix parallelism to shorten CI time on PRs; 3) Upgrade actions and node versions for security/hygiene; 4) Stabilize release automation with improved tagging and changelog generation. Changes: added .github/workflows/ci-unified-lint.yml, .github/workflows/ci-unified-test.yml, .github/workflows/release-automation.yml; introduced .github/workflows/reusable/setup-node.yml for centralized setup/caching; removed legacy workflows in .github/workflows/old/; updated action versions (actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4, actions/upload-artifact@v4) and added explicit cache keys per repo area. Migration notes: maintainers should delete stale workflow files in repo-specific directories after merge, and update any repo-level docs referencing the old workflow names. This PR also includes a small hygiene pass to the Python and TypeScript SDK CI matrices, removing node 16 and adding node 20 with conditional windows runners. Testing: ran the unified workflows in a temporary branch for ~24 hours across typical PR shapes and validated cache hit rates and median job duration improvements. See CI check list for flaky test fixes that were addressed in subsequent commits.
commits: feat(ci): add reusable setup-node workflow and base job templates
refactor(ci): create unified lint workflow and apply repo area matrices
refactor(ci): create unified test workflow with improved cache keys and parallelism
feat(release): stabilize release-automation workflow with changelog generation and tag policy
chore(deps): bump actions/checkout/setup-node/cache to v4 and remove deprecated actions
fix(ci): address flaky integration tests by increasing timeout and isolating DB setup

merge_outcome: Merged by Linnea Andersson via squash and merge. Commit message consolidated to highlight CI refactor and action bumps. Post-merge: removed three legacy workflows and announced change in #infra Slack channel with migration notes.
release_notes: CI refactor: unified lint/test/release workflows, bump GitHub Actions to v4, upgrade Node matrices to node 20, improve caching and parallelism, stabilize release automation. No behavioral changes to runtime code. Expect faster PR feedback and simpler workflow maintenance.
